name: smart_beta_intraday_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday consolidation phases compress the Keltner Channel (EMA ± 1.5×ATR) as institutional algorithms pause their directional orders to rebalance or wait for a catalyst. When ATR drops to the bottom 30th percentile of its 10-minute rolling window, the index is in a coiling state where both buy and sell resting liquidity is thin. A breakout above the upper band with simultaneous range expansion (current bar range > 1.5× 5-min average) signals that institutional demand has overwhelmed the supply ceiling — these breakouts have 30-90 second momentum continuation because the underlying directional orders are typically only partially filled and the algo continues buying. Unlike individual stocks, NIFTY breakouts from Keltner compression are cleaner because index movements aggregate multiple institutional flows rather than single-name events.

indicators.name: ema_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute EMA as Keltner channel midline. Original used 20-bar EMA on 1-min = 20-min context. Since we hold 30-90s we need a FASTER midline — 5-min captures the recent micro-trend without lagging too far behind intraday price action.

indicators.name: atr_60
indicators.formula: ATR(60) = Wilder smoothed average of true range over 60 bars
indicators.purpose: 5-minute ATR for Keltner channel width. Scaled from original's 14-bar on 1-min (14 min) to 60-bar on 5s (5 min) because our channel width must reflect the current 5-minute volatility state, not a 14-minute backward look that would make the channel too wide and insensitive to recent compression.

indicators.name: keltner_upper
indicators.purpose: Upper breakout boundary. 1.5× multiplier inherited from original — calibrated to filter noise without making the channel so wide that breakouts are rare.

indicators.name: keltner_lower
indicators.purpose: Lower breakdown boundary. Symmetric to upper band.

indicators.name: range_ratio
indicators.purpose: Current bar range divided by 5-min average bar range. Original used 20 bars on 1-min = 20 min. We use 60 bars (5 min) because at 5s resolution we need to detect WITHIN-SESSION range expansion; a 20-minute comparison base is more appropriate at 1-min frequency. Threshold 1.5× confirms expansion is meaningful, not noise.

indicators.name: atr_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute short-term ATR for volatility percentile computation. 12-bar (1-min) ATR measures the most recent volatility state, allowing us to detect compression before the breakout bar.

indicators.name: vol_percentile
indicators.purpose: Percentile rank of current short-term ATR within 10-minute rolling window. Original used 60-bar on 1-min = 60-minute window. Compressed to 10 minutes (120 bars at 5s) because intraday NIFTY volatility regimes shift faster — a 60-minute window would blend multiple distinct regime phases and obscure current compression.

indicators.name: vol_pct_lag12
indicators.purpose: Check that volatility WAS compressed 60 seconds ago — before the breakout bar. This prevents entry when the current low percentile is itself caused by the breakout bar having expanded range. The 1-minute lag cleanly separates the compression phase from the expansion phase.

indicators.name: mom_6
indicators.purpose: 30-second momentum to confirm breakout direction. Replaces original's OBV_slope (unavailable at index level — NIFTY volume is noisy aggregated futures volume). 30-second return gives directional confirmation on the breakout bar without requiring volume data.

conditions: close > keltner_upper (price breaks above Keltner upper band)
range_ratio > 1.5 (current bar range > 1.5x 5-min average range — expansion confirmed)
vol_pct_lag12 < 0.30 (ATR was in bottom 30th percentile 60 seconds ago — prior compression confirmed)
mom_6 > 0.0003 (30-second return > 3 bps — upward directional momentum)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions met on same bar; entry at bar close

conditions: close < keltner_lower (price breaks below Keltner lower band)
vol_pct_lag12 < 0.30 (volatility was compressed before this bar)
mom_6 < -0.0003 (30-second return < -3 bps — downward directional momentum)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions met on same bar; entry at bar close

exit.stop_rationale: NIFTY false Keltner breakouts from compression typically retrace 8-10 spot points before reversing — at delta ~0.5 that is 4-5 option points. A 4-point stop correctly cuts false breakouts while giving genuine breakouts room to develop.
exit.target_rationale: Genuine NIFTY Keltner compression breakouts extend 15-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds (~7-10 option points at delta 0.5). A 7-point target captures 35-50% of the expected first leg at 1:1.75 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: none — no VIX filter; volatility compression within-session is captured by vol_percentile
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST — skip first 5 min (09:15-09:20) pre-open noise
filters.volume_filter: range_ratio > 1.5 acts as implicit volume/conviction proxy at index level
filters.trend_filter: none — breakout direction is determined by which Keltner band is breached
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — Keltner compression breakouts can become over-exploited; the lagged vol_percentile and range_ratio filters together reduce false signal rate but may filter too aggressively in high-vol regimes

adaptation_notes: Three major changes from original: (1) Cross-sectional 'bottom tercile by 5-day intraday range' stock filter DROPPED — NIFTY index is always NIFTY, there is no peer universe to rank against. The compression signal is re-implemented as a within-instrument percentile rank (vol_percentile) on NIFTY's own short-term ATR. (2) OBV_slope REPLACED with 30-second momentum (mom_6) — NIFTY volume is aggregated futures+spot flow and OBV would be noisy and uninformative at 5s; price momentum at 30s is a cleaner direction confirmation signal. (3) Hold time compressed from 30-90 minutes to 30-90 SECONDS (18× compression) — the same compression-then-breakout pattern has a micro analog on NIFTY where 5-second bars within a 5-minute consolidation replicate the daily analog; the signal is real but at a much shorter timescale with proportionally smaller moves.
weaknesses: Keltner compression at 5-second resolution may have high false-breakout rate — NIFTY can spike above upper band and reverse within 1-2 bars; vol_pct_lag12 filter helps but does not eliminate this
Range expansion on a single 5-second bar can be caused by a tick gap rather than sustained institutional flow — unlike 1-min bars where range reflects sustained activity
Low trade frequency: compression + breakout + lag confirmation may only trigger 3-5 times per day on NIFTY; insufficient volume for statistically robust optimization
